entries.title: Hebrews 13:1
segments: Let brotherly love continue.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:2
segments: Do not be forgetful to entertain strangers, for by this some have entertained angels without knowing it.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:3
segments: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with [them], those who suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:4
segments: Marriage [is] honorable in all, and the bed undefiled, but fornicators and adulterers God will judge.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:5
segments: [Let your] way of life [be] without the love of money, [and be] content with such things as you have, for He has said, "Not at all will I leave you, not at all will I forsake you, never!"

entries.title: Hebrews 13:6
segments: so that we may boldly say, "[The] Lord [is] my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do to me."

entries.title: Hebrews 13:7
segments: Remember your leaders, who have spoken to you the Word of God. Follow [their] faith, considering the end of [their] conduct:

entries.title: Hebrews 13:8
segments: Jesus Christ the same yesterday and today and forever.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:9
segments: Do not be carried about with different and strange doctrines, for [it is] good for the heart to be established with grace, not with foods, in which those who have walked [in them] were not helped.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:10
segments: We have an altar of which they have no right to eat, those who serve the tabernacle.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:11
segments: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the [Holy of] Holies by the high priest for sin, are burned outside the camp.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:12
segments: Therefore Jesus also, so that He might sanctify the people with His own blood, suffered outside the gate.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:13
segments: Therefore let us go forth to Him outside the camp, bearing His reproach.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:14
segments: For here we have no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:15
segments: By Him, then, let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, [the] fruit of [our] lips, giving thanks to His name.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:16
segments: But do not forget to do good and to share, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:17
segments: Yield to your leaders, and be submissive, for they watch for your souls, [as those who must] give account, that they may do it with joy and not with grief; for that [is] unprofitable for you.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:18
segments: Pray for us; for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:19
segments: But I beseech [you] the rather to do this, so that I may be more quickly restored to you.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:20
segments: Now may the God of peace (who brought again our Lord Jesus from [the] dead, that great Shepherd of the sheep, through [the] blood of the everlasting covenant)

entries.title: Hebrews 13:21
segments: make you perfect in every good work to do His will, working in you that [which] is well pleasing in His sight through Jesus Christ, to whom [be] glory forever and ever. Amen.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:22
segments: And I beseech you, brothers, allow the word of exhortation. For I have written a letter to you in few words.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:23
segments: Know that [our] brother Timothy has been set at liberty, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:24
segments: Greet all those who have the rule over you, and all the saints. Those from Italy greet you.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:25
segments: Grace [be] with you all. Amen.
